1 Shukla) under section 498A,323, 504,427 IPC in Case Crime/FIR No.76/2022,
P.S.-Kotwali Dehat, District Balrampur including the cognizance and summoning order dated 13.08.2024 passed by learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Balrampur, in the interest of justice.
As an interim measure to stay the further proceedings of Case No. 2004/2023 (State Vs. Chakradhar Shukla) under section 498A,323, 504,427 IPC in Case Crime/FIR No.76/2022, P.S.-Kotwali Dehat, District Balrampur, during the pendency of instant petition, in the interest of justice."

entities.text: State Vs. Chakradhar Chakradhar Shukla vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Sri Pradeep Kumar Shukla, learned Counsel for the side opposite informed this Court that on 08.01.2025 P.W.1 has been examined and as such the submission of learned Counsel for the applicant that applicant be permitted to prefer discharge application before the trial court is completely misconceived and this application should be dismissed as prima-facie case is made out on bare reading of FIR as also for the reasons that all the relevant facts including the stage of trial have not been disclosed in the instant application.
Upon due consideration of aforesaid, this Court finds no force in the present application.
Accordingly, the present application is dismissed.
